name: Pigu Geliciam
source:
A girl who underwent transformative surgery at the hands of the mad genius scientist, Dr. Oama, becomes a unique hybrid of human, squid, and Puryo.

Thanks to her Puryo traits, she possesses the ability to split her physical form.

[Translated from the official site]
